A_definition: number of pairs a<b that occur in increasing order in Q
E_definition: number of triples a<b<c whose induced Q-order is one of abc, acb, bac
classification: exactly P P^R for permutations P of the alphabet
domain: alphabet size sigma >= 4; universality index 2; shortest length 2 sigma
exact_formula_for_two_arch_word: 3*C(sigma,2)+A(Q)+4*C(sigma,3)+E(Q) after normalizing first arch to increasing P
